name: Graveyard
desc1: You are standing on a path in the middle of the graveyard of
desc2: Silvermere. Headstones line the path to either side, vanishing into
desc3: the opalescent white mist shrouding the area. Clammy tendrils of this
desc4: shimmering mist curl around your ankles, chilling you to the bone, and
desc5: the mournful howl of the wind makes you uneasy.
